scope: Synthetic PRF-like finite-strain material point: the 88 Hencky Prony viscous network (F=FeFv) in parallel with an equilibrium network whose deviatoric part is J2 elastoplastic with linear isotropic hardening (F=FeFp, exponential-map radial return on Kirchhoff stress in principal log space). General-F stepping API and traction-free uniaxial driver. Not calibrated, not compared with measurements, not a PRF compatibility claim.

syntheticParameters.note: K, mu and branches are the same synthetic values as 72/88; yieldStressPa and hardeningModulusPa are synthetic test values, not material constants

comparisonWithJ2Return.note: viscous branch tau=1e-6 s with dt=0.05 s (fully relaxed) so only the equilibrium network acts; reference is src/plasticity-core.js j2Return under uniaxial stress with E11 as small strain; loop +a, a/4, -a/2, +a

verification: small-strain limit agrees with j2Return (sigma11 and equivalent plastic strain), 3% shows recorded finite-strain gap
objectivity under superposed time-varying rotation with plastic flow; pure rigid rotation stress- and flow-free

load-hold-unload(partial)-hold-reload: traction-free faces, monotone viscous/plastic dissipation, elastic unloading (no plastic increment), relaxation and recovery, reload flow only near the previous peak, work = stored + dissipated within 2%
residual: unloading to the plastic axial strain and holding long gives |sigma11| < 1e-3 of peak
rejection of calibrated claims, H<=0, extra fields, out-of-envelope strain, forged state; inputs unchanged
unverified: the equilibrium network keeps flowing during strain-hold because lateral contraction changes while branches relax (physical within the model, not checked against data)
plastic dissipation reported as sy*dgamma (same convention as j2Return); the backward-Euler excess H*dgamma^2/2 is not separately booked
no consistent tangent, element, damage, softening, necking, kinematic hardening or rate-dependent plasticity
stretch envelope 0.95-1.05 inherited; no calibration or measured comparison
